confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. The shekel-dollar basis is assumed near 3.3 ILS per USD, and July demand adds uncertainty. Dining and cafe anchors are moderately confident; hostel and hotel rates are least certain. Cocktail and wine were set relative to draft beer where direct recall was weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single named comparable. Restaurant and cafe levels were benchmarked against high-cost Southern European coastal tourist cities and adjusted upward for Israeli restaurant and alcohol prices. Accommodation reflects Tel Aviv's July peak demand.
